anchor_caveat: The guide anchors encode target poses/rest-length geometry, not anatomical source landmarks. Prior measurements: hip target (668.08,312.24) is 23.56px from nearest back-thigh retained source; back-hip target (645.07,312.24) is 21.76px below nearest old back-thigh source point; front ankle target (1227.26,483.52) is 44.30px from retained front-calf source; back ankle target (250.71,564.27) is 90.05px from retained rear-calf source. Do not move canonical bones from this partition alone.
unresolved_visual_review: Hip seam ownership remains low confidence; root must review the dark crease and the 10-pixel outer contour before any binding.
The front boot shaft begins near y=389 while the guide ankle target is y≈484; this is a visible source/target landmark mismatch, not solved by claiming an underlap.
The source has no independently exposed hidden overlap. Seam-band masks are proposals only and are not added to the unique owner RGBA parts.
Every owner's component count/holes are recorded. A multi-component part, gap, or isolated contour detail is not silently accepted; root must inspect the per-part gray triptych and 4x nearest image.
This source proposal does not validate normal maps, material style, pose registration, deformation, or Forward+.
